newsitem.title: TOGO: Presidents of Togo, Benin leave for food summit.
newsitem.headline: Presidents of Togo, Benin leave for food summit.

text.p: Togolese President Gnassingbe Eyadema and the head of state of neighbouring Benin, Matthew Kerekou, left together on Monday to attend this week's World Food Summit in Rome, officials said.
Kerekou arrived earlier from Cotonou and the two men then boarded the same plane for Italy.

Togolese officials said Eyadema, one of Africa's longest serving heads of state, would make proposals for food security in the region in his speech at the five-day U.N.-organised summit from Wednesday.
